method: The smallest multiple of 0.25 strictly above the best bm25 score any prompt of negative-queries.json reaches on the mixed index of this corpus (cards, minutes and work records, built as recall-inputs.ts builds it), with the recall core's own tokenizer. No margin beyond the step (TCRN-CROSS-MIN-164 D4). Recompute with node scripts/retrieval-eval.mjs --calibrate; the gate refuses a threshold the rule does not give on the corpus it names.
